name: Shadcn Admin Kit
summary: Component kit for building React admin apps with shadcn/ui: CRUD pages, data tables, forms and auth.
description: A component kit to build admin apps with shadcn/ui, built on Ra-Core. Provides working List, Show, Edit and Create pages, a data table with sorting, filtering, export, bulk actions and pagination, data-bound forms, reference editing, login and access control, a dashboard, and guessers that scaffold components from an API response. Works with any REST or GraphQL API and with Vite, Remix or Next.js.
contains: CRUD pages: list, show, edit, create
data table with sorting, filtering, export, bulk actions, column selection and pagination
forms with data binding and validation, plus reference views
login, auth check and access control with any backend
guessers scaffold components from API responses
i18n, light/dark mode, any REST or GraphQL API
shadcn registry items measured on the repo
